title: 정보보호 분야 SQF 직무역량체계도
notes: 정보보호 분야의 5개 하위산업분야와 15개 직무를 제시한다. 위키의 세부 직함은 채용 공고와 다른 공식 직무 프로필을 함께 고려해 확장했다.

title: NICE Framework: Current Versions
notes: Components contain Work Role Categories, Work Roles, Competency Areas, and TKS statements. Official pages have inconsistent date labels, so the component release date is not asserted here.

title: NICE Framework Change Logs
notes: Records the new Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Work Role and changes to Cryptography and DevSecOps Competency Areas.

title: Getting Started with the NICE Framework
notes: The page currently lists 42 Work Roles in five categories, while NIST's Occupations, Jobs, and Work Roles page says 52 in seven. Do not present either count as settled without reconciling the official pages.

title: Occupations, Jobs, and Work Roles
notes: Distinguishes a framework Work Role from an employer's specific job.

title: European Cybersecurity Skills Framework (ECSF)
version: 2022 framework; revision in progress at review time
notes: Overview of 12 representative professional profiles; ENISA states that the ECSF is being revised.

title: European Cybersecurity Skills Framework Role Profiles
notes: Primary role-profile publication covering missions, tasks, knowledge, skills, and alternative titles.

title: Cyber Career Pathways Tool
version: tool data: NICE Components 2.0.0 (stated on page)
notes: Useful for comparing Work Roles and related TKS. Tool data lags the current NICE 2.2.0 Components; some visits returned HTTP 403.

title: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
notes: Risk management outcomes and six functions; this is not a job-title taxonomy.

title: Secure Software Development Framework
notes: Reference for secure software development practices and software supply chain work.

title: Zero Trust Architecture
notes: Architecture and access-control approach, not a standalone product category.

title: OWASP Top 10:2025
notes: Web application security risk awareness document; apply to appropriate technology context.

title: OWASP API Security Top 10
notes: API-specific security risk list.

title: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series
notes: Topic-specific secure implementation guidance; cite the individual cheat sheet where possible.

title: MITRE ATT&CK
notes: Adversary tactics and techniques; cite specific techniques for technical claims.

title: Common Weakness Enumeration
notes: Software and hardware weakness taxonomy; distinguish weakness from a specific CVE.

title: National Vulnerability Database
notes: Vulnerability records and enrichment; the home page loaded but automated text extraction returned no body, so no database totals are asserted.

title: Cloud Native Computing Foundation
notes: Entry point for cloud native projects; cite a project or specification page for technical claims.

title: Kubernetes Documentation
notes: Official platform documentation; individual pages should be checked against the version selector.

title: AWS Security Documentation
notes: AWS security documentation hub; cite service-level docs for product behavior.

title: Microsoft Security documentation
notes: Security documentation hub, including Microsoft security products and identity resources.

title: Google Cloud Security
notes: Official security overview; use Google Cloud product documentation for precise technical details.

title: OWASP Gen AI Security Project
notes: Entry point for generative AI and LLM application security resources.

title: KISA 사이버보안 교육 추진 안내
notes: Lists Security Gym, K-Shield, K-Shield Junior, and AI security monitoring training; training names are not proof of hiring demand.

title: NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices for Systems and Organizations
notes: Official C-SCRM guidance on strategies, policies, plans, and product/service risk assessments; it does not set hiring requirements.

title: NIST SP 1326: C-SCRM Due Diligence Assessment Quick-Start Guide
notes: Describes due diligence for ICT suppliers and products. The scope is guidance for assessment work, not a job taxonomy.

title: Vendor Security Manager
notes: Employer ATS search-indexed posting covers vendor assessments, risk tiering, monitoring, decision records, and collaboration. Direct HTML requires JavaScript; no publication date was verified.

title: Open Source Project Security Baseline
notes: Project security controls by maturity and category for maintainers; not evidence of the number of dedicated jobs.

title: Guide to implementing a coordinated vulnerability disclosure process for open source projects
notes: Explains private report intake, coordination, remediation, and communication for OSS project maintainers; projects may adapt its advice.

title: Security Engineer (Home Assistant)
notes: Employer ATS search-indexed posting covers private report intake, maintainer coordination, release security, and open-source community collaboration. Direct HTML requires JavaScript; no publication date was verified.

title: 안랩, 2025년 연구개발 직군 신입사원 및 주니어 공개채용 실시
notes: Security analysis, vulnerability analysis and digital forensics appeared among ten R&D fields open to new and junior applicants. Field-specific requirements differed; this is not a current vacancy.

title: 2026년 한국농수산식품유통공사 신입직원 채용공고
notes: New-hire privacy field required 정보보안기사 and TOEIC 700 in this one public-sector posting; these are not universal entry requirements.

title: IT Security Specialist (신입 / 2년 이하)
notes: One-year contract for internal IT device/software support and account/permission work. Security Manager and Infra Security Engineer are possible future paths stated by the employer, not the current duties or guaranteed transitions.

title: 정보보호 및 개인정보보호 관리체계 인증(ISMS-P)
notes: Defines the ISMS-P and ISMS certification types and describes KISA's operating role. Certification status is not a hiring requirement by itself.

title: Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) Tool
notes: Direct definition of a SIEM tool in the official NIST glossary; does not prescribe a specific role title.

title: 시큐아이 경력사원 모집: 영업
notes: Direct company posting for enterprise and overseas security-solution sales. It requires prior sales experience and does not explicitly advertise a presales engineer or PoC duty.

title: 시큐아이 경력사원 모집: 보안컨설팅
notes: Three consulting fields combine assessments, penetration testing and project management; all require at least seven years in this posting. One field also lists incident, forensic and malware analysis. Contract employment with review for regular conversion.

title: 시큐아이 경력사원 모집: 보안운영
notes: Four operational fields cover SIEM, network controls, security solutions and 24x365 EDR monitoring. Shift work is stated for field IV only; no on-call requirement is stated. Contract employment with review for regular conversion.

title: False Positive
notes: Direct NIST definitions include incorrectly classifying benign activity or content as malicious; use the security-operations sense in this wiki.

title: Rules of Engagement (ROE)
notes: Defines agreed testing constraints and authority established before a security test. It is a career-scoping term here, not a testing procedure.

title: Security Engineer, Detection and Response
notes: Employer ATS describes participation in a shared on-call rotation for incident response. US full-time hybrid role; this is not a universal Korean employment condition.

title: Principal Technical Consultant - Network Security
notes: Employer posting describes work on-site at client facilities or leading remote delivery, and travel of at least 25 percent. It does not establish a Korean dispatch-employment classification.

title: Sales Engineer
notes: Employer ATS explicitly combines technical discovery, demos and proof-of-concept deployment design in a sales engineering role. US on-site role; not evidence of Korean hiring frequency.

title: Security Engineer (보안 인프라)
notes: Current employer posting on hybrid infrastructure, network segmentation, workload security baselines and access architecture. Separate posting ID from the former P19 URL, which now returns 404.

title: Security Engineer (이벤트 분석/사고 대응)
notes: Current employer posting on SIEM monitoring, log correlation, incident analysis/response and automation. Separate posting ID from the former P21 URL, which now returns 404.
